change: Implement the existing device-position append_steps interface for SYCL and use it for verifier QSA commit; one ordered append kernel per layer instead of one per window slot. The single-token path is unchanged.
baseline: Current retained GDN ESIMD and fused history/state commit; only QSA indexer commit changes in the new engine.
measurement_scope: QSA commit operator stage only, including tail snapshot restoration for 12 independent layers. No fresh steady-state whole-model decode/prefill speedup measurement. Do not add or multiply earlier percentages.

confirmation.method: Three fresh processes, each shape runs A/B/A/B/A within one process using the same kernel object. A uses the existing single-token append; B uses device-position append_steps. Submit thread pinned consistently and benchmark process priority above normal on both arms. Each phase resets state, validates all state words and block positions, warms three batches of 256 sequences, and retains nine batches of 256 sequences with one queue completion per batch. Phase medians are combined by the median of three A and two B phases per process, then the median across processes. The conservative comparison is the slowest B phase median versus the fastest A phase median across every process; no phase is discarded.
confirmation.conditions: A770, Windows 10, driver 32.0.101.9034, DPC++ 2025.3.2, Level Zero; 12 separate layers, indexer width128/block4, capacity8192, start cell2049, four/six-slot windows, acceptance1..capacity.
confirmation.unit: microseconds per 12-layer QSA commit sequence, including host submission through queue completion
confirmation.limits: Baseline drift exceeds 3%; median reductions are observations, not a precision claim or whole-model adoption gate. Adoption is supported by bitwise correctness and every candidate phase median remaining more than 10% faster than every baseline phase median for the same shape, across all three processes.

excluded_short_batch_screen.use: Correctness support only; short batches had large baseline drift and do not supply the documented timing table.

correctness.coverage: Capacities1/2/4/6/8; zero through full acceptance; all four pooling offsets; capacity edge and invalid positions; nonzero base, none/linear/YaRN, optional RoPE table and multimodal position table; CPU F16 tail oracle, full-state bitwise parity, state/position boundary canaries, zero/strided device positions, no-op and negative stride guards; six replays of one captured graph with changed device contents.

integrated_model_validation.scope: Four cold correctness requests, not steady-state decode/prefill measurements.
